items.title: 15.5.1 Central Nervous System - Brain & Spinal Cord (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the brain and spinal cord (PDF 36-40).

blocks.text: CNS (dimagh aur spinal cord) inter-neurons aur neuroglia se bana hai. Dimagh cranium (khopri) ke andar band hai, jabke spinal cord vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) ke andar. Dono hifazati meninges se dhake hain, jo membranes ki teen tahon par mushtamil hain:

items: Sab se bahar wali moti teh (khopri aur vertebrae ke neeche) dura mater kehlati hai. Is mein bari khoon ki nalyan hoti hain.
Doosri teh (dura mater ke neeche) patli hai aur arachnoid kehlati hai. Yeh apne neeche maujood cerebrospinal fluid aur dura mater ke khoon ke darmiyan rukawat (barrier) ka kaam karti hai.

Teesri teh bohat nazuk membrane hai jise pia mater kehte hain. Yeh dimagh aur spinal cord ki sateh se chipki hoti hai aur is mein khoon ki capillaries hain jo dimagh aur spinal cord ko ghiza deti hain.

blocks.alt: Sar ke oopri hisse ka mura hua tukra: bahar se andar skull (khopri), dura mater, patli arachnoid, arachnoid aur pia mater ke darmiyan jaali-numa reshon wali jagah, pia mater aur dimagh ka tissue.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.9: Dimagh ki meninges (jhilliyan) (kitab ki Figure 15.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Skull, Dura mater, Arachnoid, Space between arachnoid & pia mater, Pia mater, Brain tissue.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar se andar ki taraf parhein: skull (khopri), phir moti dura mater, phir patli arachnoid, phir jaali-numa reshon wali khaali jagah (jis mein cerebrospinal fluid hota hai), phir dimagh se chipki pia mater, aur aakhir mein dimagh ka tissue.
Dimagh ki banawat

Ek ausat baligh insan ka dimagh 1.4 kg (jism ke kul wazan ka taqreeban 2 percent) hota hai. Is mein taqreeban 100 arab (billion) inter-neurons hain. Har neuron ke kai hazaar doosre neurons ke saath synapses hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Grade X mein aap ne dimagh ki purani (traditional) taqseem parhi thi, yaani forebrain, midbrain aur hindbrain. Yahan aap dimagh ki banawat nayi muqarrar shuda taqseem ke mutabiq parhenge.

blocks.alt: Cranium (khopri) ke andar dimagh ka darmiyani kata hua manzar. Tehdar cerebrum corpus callosum ke oopar mehrab banata hai; neeche lateral ventricles, third ventricle, thalamus aur hypothalamus (diencephalon) aur pituitary gland hain. Midbrain, pons aur medulla oblongata (brainstem) neeche spinal cord tak jate hain; peeche cerebellum aur darmiyan fourth ventricle hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.10: Insani dimagh ke bare hisse (kitab ki Figure 15.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Lateral ventricles, Third ventricle, Cranium (Skull), Pituitary gland, Fourth ventricle, Cerebrum, Corpus callosum, Thalamus aur Hypothalamus (Diencephalon ka bracket), Midbrain, Pons aur Medulla oblongata (Brainstem ka bracket), Cerebellum, Spinal cord.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure mein chaar bare hisse dhoondein: oopar bara tehdar cerebrum, beech mein thalamus aur hypothalamus (diencephalon), neeche midbrain, pons aur medulla oblongata (brainstem) jo spinal cord se jure hain, aur peeche chhota tehdar cerebellum. Ventricles (khaali khane) bhi dekhein.
Insani dimagh ke bare hisse yeh hain:
1- Cerebrum

Yeh insani dimagh ka sab se bara hissa hai. Is ki bahari teh bohat tehdar (folded) hai. Ek gehri nali (groove ya fissure) ise do hisson mein baant'ti hai jinhein baayan aur daayan cerebral hemisphere kehte hain. Gehri nali ki tah par dono hemispheres corpus callosum (axons ki ek patti) se jure hain. Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif (opposite) taraf se hissi maloomat leta hai aur usi taraf ko motor hukm bhejta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Ek hemisphere ko nuqsan pohanchne se jism ki mukhalif taraf ehsas khatam ho jata hai aur falij (paralysis) ho jata hai.
Har cerebral hemisphere chaar lobes mein batta hua hai:

items: Frontal lobes intizami kaamon (executive functions) se jure hain, jaise apne aap par qaboo (self-control), mansooba bandi (planning), dalil dena (reasoning) aur gehri soch (abstract thought).
Parietal lobes hissi maloomat process karte hain, jism ki position aur mahol ka ehsas dete hain, tawajjuh (attention) qaboo karte hain, aur harkat ka mansooba bana kar use anjaam dete hain.
Temporal lobes hissi maloomat ko process kar ke nazar ki yaad (visual memory) mehfooz rakhne, zaban samajhne aur jazbat mein hissa lete hain.
Occipital lobes nazar (vision) ko qaboo karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen cerebral hemisphere ka pehlu se manzar, aagay ka hissa baayen. Frontal lobe (peela-hara) aagay, parietal lobe (neela) oopar central nali ke peeche, occipital lobe (bhoora) peeche aur temporal lobe (hara) lateral fissure ke neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.11: Cerebrum ke chaar lobes (kitab ki Figure 15.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Frontal lobe, Parietal lobe, Temporal lobe, Occipital lobe.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Cerebral hemispheres par ubhre hue hisson ko gyri (wahid: gyrus) kehte hain. Gyri ko naliyan (grooves) alag karti hain. Uthli nali ko sulcus (jama: sulci) aur gehri nali ko fissure kehte hain.

Cerebral cortex: yeh cerebrum ki tehdar bahari teh hai. Yeh grey matter (cell bodies aur non-myelinated axons wala) se bani hai. Is mein inter-neurons bohat ghane bhare hain (dimagh ke tamam neurons ka taqreeban 10%). Is mein yeh areas hain:

items: Motor areas iradi (skeletal) muscles ko impulses bhejte hain.

Sensory areas jism ke mukhtalif hisson se maloomat lete hain. Temporal lobe ke andar ek khaas area, auditory cortex, mukhtalif awazon ki frequencies ko sambhalta hai. Occipital lobe ka visual cortex aankh se aane wali maloomat ko sambhalta hai.

Cortex ke association areas aala zehni kaamon (higher mental activities) ki jagah hain. Kuch kaam sirf ek taraf se jure hain, jaise zaban baayen taraf aur nazar-o-fasle ki samajh (visual-spatial ability) daayen taraf.

blocks.alt: Cerebral hemisphere ka pehlu se manzar, aagay ka hissa daayen, hisson ke rang: primary motor area (gulabi patti) primary sensory area (neeli patti) ke aagay; aagay somatic association area; sensory patti ke peeche somatic sensory & association area; peeche visual association area aur visual area; temporal lobe mein auditory cortex (peela) aur us ke pichle sire par sensory area for speech; aagay motor patti ke qareeb motor area for speech.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.12: Sensory, motor aur association areas (kitab ki Figure 15.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Primary Sensory area, Somatic sensory & association area, Visual association area, Visual area, Primary motor area, Somatic Association area, Motor area for speech, Sensory area for speech, Auditory cortex.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rangon se areas pehchanein: gulabi patti primary motor area hai (muscles ko hukm), us ke theek peeche neeli patti primary sensory area (jism se ehsas). Peeche visual area (nazar), temporal lobe mein auditory cortex (sunna), aur speech ke liye do alag areas: aage motor area for speech (bolna) aur peeche sensory area for speech (samajhna).
Cerebral cortex ke neeche white matter hai (myelinated axons se bana). Yeh cortex ke khaas hisson ko aapas mein aur doosre asabi markazon (neural centres) se jorta hai.
2- Brainstem
Cerebrum brainstem ke zariye spinal cord se jura hai. Yeh hissa cerebrum ke neeche hai aur is ke teen bare hisse hain:

items: Midbrain: yeh nazar aur sunne ki maloomat aage pohanchata (relay karta) hai. Is mein reticular formation bhi hai jo hindbrain ko forebrain se jorti hai.
Pons: yeh cerebral hemispheres aur cerebellum ke darmiyan impulses pohanchata hai.
Medulla oblongata: yeh relay centre bhi hai aur dil ki dharkan, saans ki raftar aur doosre homeostatic kaamon ka control centre bhi.

blocks.text: 3- Diencephalon
Yeh dimagh ke beech mein gehrai mein, brainstem ke oopar aur cerebrum ke neeche (khaas taur par dono cerebral hemispheres ke darmiyan) hai. Is ke do bare hisse hain:

items: Thalamus hissi maloomat aur cerebrum ke darmiyan relay centre hai.

Hypothalamus andaruni aaza (visceral) ke kaamon ko murattab karta hai. Yeh jism ka darja-e-hararat, bhook aur pet bharne ka ehsas (satiety), pyaas aur mukhtalif jazbati halaton ko qaboo karta hai. Yeh pituitary gland ko bhi qaboo karta hai, jo aage bohat se doosre endocrine glands ko qaboo karti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Pineal gland us jagah hai jahan thalamus ke dono hisse milte hain. Yeh melatonin hormone banati hai jo neend ke andaz ko qaboo karta hai.
Limbic system

Yeh aapas mein jure hue hisson ka group hai. Yeh thalamus ke dono taraf, cerebrum ke bilkul neeche hai. Is mein hypothalamus, amygdala, hippocampus aur qareeb ke kai doosre hisse shamil hain. Amygdalae (wahid: amygdala) do badam-numa (almond-shaped) hisse hain jo temporal lobes mein gehrai mein hain. Yeh mohabbat, nafrat, ghussa, dar, ghazab aur jinsi ubhaar ke ehsasat aur jazbat ko qaboo karte hain. Hippocampus do "seengon" (horns) par mushtamil hai jo amygdala se peeche ki taraf mudte hain. Yeh maloomat ko thori der ki yaad (short-term memory) se lambi yaad (long-term memory) mein pakka karne mein kirdar ada karta hai.

blocks.alt: Dimagh ka darmiyani kata hua manzar aur limbic system: thalamus ke agle hisse ke neeche hypothalamus (hara), temporal lobe mein gehra badam-numa amygdala (daire mein), aur us se peeche mudta hippocampus; fornix thalamus ke oopar mehrab banata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.13: Limbic system (kitab ki Figure 15.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 4- Cerebellum

Yeh dimagh ka doosra bara hissa hai. Yeh cerebral hemispheres ke neeche aur peeche hai. Yeh muscles ke kaamon ko coordinate karta hai. Yeh cortex ki ek kas kar tehdar teh aur us ke neeche white matter se bana hai. Yeh muscles, tendons, jodon (joints), aankhon aur kaanon se hissi impulses leta hai, aur dimagh ke doosre markazon se bhi maloomat leta hai. Yeh jism ki position ki maloomat process kar ke jism ka andaz (posture) qaboo karta hai. Cerebellum tez aur musalsal harkaton ko coordinate karta hai. Yeh brainstem aur cerebral cortex ke saath mil kar skeletal muscles ko coordinate karta hai.
Dimagh ke ventricles

Dimagh aur spinal cord khokhle (hollow) hain, yaani in mein maya (fluid) se bhare khane hain jinhein ventricles kehte hain. Insani dimagh mein chaar ventricles hain. Cerebrum mein do bare lateral ventricles hain. Teesra (third) ventricle diencephalon mein daayen aur baayen thalamus ke darmiyan hai. Chautha (fourth) ventricle cerebellum aur brainstem ke darmiyan hai aur spinal cord ki central canal se mila hua hai. Ventricles ka asal kaam cerebrospinal fluid banana aur use gardish dena hai.
Spinal cord ki banawat

Spinal cord neurons ki ek taar (cable) hai jo dimagh ke medulla oblongata se reerh ki haddi (backbone) mein neeche tak jati hai. Yeh vertebral column aur meninges ki tahon mein band aur mehfooz hai. Dimagh ki tarah spinal cord ke neurons aur neuroglia bhi grey aur white matter banate hain, lekin spinal cord mein grey aur white matter ki tarteeb dimagh ke ulat hai.

blocks.alt: Spinal cord ka cross-section: white matter ke andar H-numa grey matter, aur har taraf ganglion wali dorsal root aur ventral root jo mil kar spinal nerve banati hain. Sensory neuron (gulabi) receptors se ganglion aur dorsal root ke raaste grey matter ke interneuron tak aata hai; motor neuron (neela) ventral root aur spinal nerve se effectors tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.14: Spinal cord aur spinal nerves ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 15.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Axon of Sensory neuron, Dorsal root, Interneuron, Ganglion, from receptors, to effectors, Spinal nerve, Axon of motor neuron, Ventral root, Grey matter, White matter.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do rangon ka raasta dekhein. Gulabi sensory neuron receptors se signal la kar dorsal root se andar aata hai; us ki cell body bahar ganglion mein hai. Grey matter mein interneuron signal aage deta hai. Neela motor neuron ventral root se bahar ja kar effectors (muscles ya glands) tak hukm le jata hai. Dorsal aur ventral roots mil kar ek spinal nerve banate hain, is liye har spinal nerve mixed hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Spinal cord ka diameter 0.25 se 0.5 inch hai. Yeh cervical (gardan) aur lumbar (kamar) hisson mein zyada chaura hai. Cervical hisse mein yeh baazuon aur dhar (trunk) ki hissi maloomat aur motor hukm sambhalta hai. Lumbar hisse mein yeh taangon ki hissi maloomat aur motor hukm sambhalta hai.

Spinal cord ke andar do hisse (zones) hain. Andar wala H-numa ya titli-numa (butterfly-shaped) hissa grey matter se bana hai. Is mein inter-neurons aur motor neurons ki cell bodies hain. Is mein neuroglia cells aur non-myelinated axons bhi hain. Bahar wala hissa white matter se bana hai jis mein myelinated axons hain. Andar wale hisse mein beech mein maya se bhari ek canal bhi hai, jo dimagh ke chauthe ventricle ka tasalsul (continuation) hai. Spinal cord maloomat ki shahrah (highway) hai jis par jism aur dimagh ke darmiyan paigham aate jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Jo shakhs tawazun qaim na rakh sake us ke dimagh ka kaun sa hissa mutasir hoga, aur jis ki saans ki raftar bigar jaye us ka kaun sa?
blocks.explanation: Tawazun aur posture: cerebellum. Saans ki raftar: brainstem ka medulla oblongata.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Meninges: dura mater (bahar, moti), arachnoid (beech, CSF is ke neeche), pia mater (andar, nazuk).

Dimagh: cerebrum (do hemispheres, corpus callosum, chaar lobes, cortex ke motor, sensory aur association areas), brainstem (midbrain, pons, medulla), diencephalon (thalamus, hypothalamus), limbic system, cerebellum; chaar ventricles.
Spinal cord: andar H-numa grey matter, bahar white matter, beech mein central canal; dimagh ke ulat tarteeb.
